patch.name: C0 Off-field Geo Skill
patch.notesEn: Transient Blossoms scale with DEF and deal Skill damage. Use DEF sands, Geo DMG goblet and a CRIT circlet. Favor CRIT and DEF; ER matters only if casting Burst on purpose. Harbinger of Dawn is a free R5 option if owned and its CRIT Rate passive needs HP above 90%. Flute of Ezpitzal makes DEF easier to meet and avoids the HP condition. Uraku benefits from nearby party Geo damage; Primordial Jade Cutter is an owned CRIT stat stick. Golden Troupe rewards off-field Skill damage and Husk rewards building DEF and Geo stacks. Archaic Petra is situational for elemental teammates when Albedo can collect the matching Crystallize shard; skip it in the listed mono-Geo team. Gorou buffs DEF and Geo, Zhongli shields, and Itto drives; this lineup does not assume the two-character Hexerei team bonus.

patch.name: C0 Burst healer and Dendro support
patch.notesEn: Meet the 80-Energy Burst requirement first: use ER sands until the planned rotation works, then consider HP%. Use an HP% goblet; an HP% circlet supports healing and the reaction buff up to 50,000 Max HP, Healing Bonus prioritizes sustain, and CRIT Rate is situational for Favonius. Favonius Codex needs an on-field CRIT hit; Prototype Amber refunds personal Energy and heals the party after Burst, while Jadefall restores Energy after Burst or shield creation. Skill heals the team; Burst sustains the active character. Use Deepwood when the team needs a holder and his hits cover the target, or Noblesse when Nahida holds Deepwood and an ATK buff is useful. In Cyno Quickbloom, Nahida supplies Dendro, Xingqiu needs normal-attack triggers and Baizhu sustains. Check Energy and new-wave Dendro application before extending Cyno’s field time.

patch.name: C0 Off-field multi-target Electro
patch.notesEn: Stormbreaker favors enemies close enough for bounces. Sucrose drives with normal-attack hits and Swirls, Fischl supplies Electro particles and Xingqiu applies Hydro through normal attacks. The lineup relies on damage reduction and limited sustain; C0 has no C1 shield, and Raiden’s Burst attacks do not trigger Stormbreaker. Meet the 80-Energy Burst requirement first; use ER sands if needed or ATK% once uptime is covered. Electro goblet and CRIT circlet support Burst damage. Emblem rewards ER and Burst damage; mixed Burst DMG and ATK sets are a fallback. Wolf’s Gravestone remains useful without its low-HP proc; Serpent Spine needs maintained stacks, Favonius needs on-field CRIT hits, and Prototype Archaic R5 is a craftable ATK option without assuming its normal-attack proc.

patch.name: C0 Burst buffer and heal
patch.notesEn: Use an Energy Recharge Sands until Fantastic Voyage is available on each planned rotation. HP% Sands is a healing alternative only after that requirement is met. The Burst ATK bonus uses Bennett’s innate Base ATK plus the sword’s Base ATK; artifact ATK% does not increase it. At C0 the active character needs above 70% HP for the buff. Use Healing Bonus normally or CRIT Rate when relying on an on-field Favonius crit. Shortlist: Sapwood Blade for craftable ER and base ATK, Aquila Favonia for base ATK only if ER is covered, Skyward Blade for ER plus base ATK, and Favonius Sword when team energy outweighs the smaller ATK buff. Assign one Noblesse holder; Instructor is a four-star alternative when Bennett triggers a reaction on field and the team values EM. The Xiangling–Xingqiu–Sucrose rotation is an optional example, not a replacement for existing teams.

patch.name: C0 Off-field Oz in Aggravate
patch.notesEn: ATK% Sands is the general off-field default. Consider EM Sands in a stable Quicken/Aggravate rotation only if the weapon, team buffs and substats support it; compare with ATK rather than assuming it wins. Electro goblet, CRIT circlet and Skill > Burst > Normal Attack remain. Meet the chosen Oz renewal cadence with ER; no fixed target is assumed. Song of Stillness needs actual healing on Fischl before creating or resummoning Oz to snapshot its damage buff. At C0 Fischl cannot rely on her own C4 heal. A later Yaoyao heal can trigger or refresh the weapon buff even off field, but does not retroactively update existing Oz. Polar Star stack types are independent; set up inexpensive Normal/Aimed hits when practical, avoid assuming four stacks, and establish desired stacks before the Oz snapshot. Keqing drives Electro application, Nahida maintains Dendro and Yaoyao adds healing; the named team remains experimental.

patch.name: C0 Off-field Vaporize Burst
patch.notesEn: Use Energy Recharge Sands until the 80-Energy Pyronado is ready on the intended rotation. Once Energy is covered, ATK% is a straightforward option for raw Pyro damage or inconsistent Vaporize; EM is conditional on Xiangling owning frequent reactions. Cast Pyronado after applicable Bennett buffs are active and catch Bennett Skill particles on Xiangling for the next Burst. Pyronado snapshots eligible character stats; enemy-state effects such as Dragon’s Bane depend on the aura at each hit. The Catch R5 adds ER and Burst damage/CRIT and is obtainable through fishing. Engulfing Lightning converts excess ER to ATK and grants temporary ER after Burst. Favonius needs a critical hit while Xiangling is on field. Dragon’s Bane is for reliable Hydro/Pyro aura once Energy is covered. Emblem is the general Burst set; mixed sets and Crimson Witch remain situational. Xingqiu needs normal-attack triggers and Bennett supplies Pyro particles. The Sucrose lineup is one example alongside retained Melt, Vaporize, Overvape and mono-Pyro teams.
